verdict.rationale: Browserbase ships a first-party Agent that users create from the dashboard by describing a goal in natural language. Supporting docs show it can run on a schedule or on demand, pause to ask the user for input and then resume, handle downloaded files, and have completed runs optimized in the dashboard's run view. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the built-in Agent, and documentation of a conversational in-product assistant beyond goal-based agent runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Create your Browserbase Agent from the dashboard by describing the goal in natural language.
Deploy and run browser agents on Browserbase, on a schedule or on demand.
With `pauseWhen`, the Agent can pause the run, tell you what it needs, and continue exactly where it left off once you reply.
The Optimize tool lives in the Agent run view in the dashboard
